entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, your partner in peak performance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thanks for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I need to start a return for a VeloBand Pulse I bought. It's just not for me.
I can certainly help with that. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309.
Got it. One moment... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse, delivered 14 days ago. Not a problem at all. You're well within our 90-day return window.
Oh, 90 days? That's great! I was worried I might have missed the cutoff. Perfect, let's get that process started.
Absolutely. Let me just pull up the return authorization form and... oh. Hold on one second, sir.
Is there a problem?
My apologies, sir, I seem to have misspoken. I was looking at our standard policy. It appears that for specific electronics like the VeloBand Pulse, there's a strict 10-day return window.
What? But **you just said** it was 90 days! I was literally about to box it up.
I understand your frustration, and I sincerely apologize for my error. The 90-day policy applies to our apparel and most gear, but the Pulse has a specific policy.
This is unbelievable. I hope this is a **recorded line**, because you flat out **promised me** I could return this! Are you telling me I'm stuck with a $150 device because of your mistake?
Sir, I am very sorry for the confusion I caused. The system physically won't let me generate a return label for this item because it's past the 10-day mark.

This feels like a classic **bait and switch**. You tell me one thing to keep me happy, then pull the rug out from under me. I've been a VIP member for five years! Is this how you treat loyal customers?
I see your VIP status, and I truly value your business. While I can't process the refund, for the misinformation, I can offer you a $50 credit to your VeloFit account.
I don't want a credit! I want my money back for the product you told me I could return! This is unacceptable. Get me your supervisor. Now.
Of course. Please hold one moment while I connect you.
Hello, my name is Sarah, I'm a supervisor here at VeloFit. I understand there's been some frustration with a return request?
Frustration is putting it mildly. Your agent told me I could return this, and then completely changed his story. I want this handled.

I completely understand, and I've been briefed on the situation. Let me first apologize for the conflicting information you received. That is not the experience we want for our VIP members. Let's see what we can do to make this right.
